voiceGuide: An interactive learning experience where children explore the five senses by identifying actions in a park scene.

welcome.text: Welcome! Let's learn about our Five Senses. Click on a character to check which sense they are using.

sense_taste.text: Taste! I taste the yummy ice cream.

sense_smell.text: Smell! I smell the beautiful flower.

sense_sight.text: Sight! I see the little bird.
